lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll separate two vowels that Portuguese puts in the very same place. They’re... …/ʌ/ and /ɝ/! One is short and open. The other is long: work

/ɝ/ does not exist in Portuguese, so we replace it with the closest vowel. Then work sounds like walk, and the listener has to guess from context.
